call_points.text: Management reiterated its vision of ₹5,000 Cr revenue and ₹1,000 Cr+ EBITDA by FY29-30.
EBITDA margins are expected to sustain north of 20%, supported by operational efficiency and enhanced product mix.
Privi and Givaudan together invested ₹50 Cr equity in PRIGIV expansion, now under implementation.
Evaluating additional capex for high-value specialty molecules with revenue potential of ~₹100+ Cr.
Net debt to EBITDA improved 32.1% YoY to 1.07x and net debt to equity reached 0.51x as of September 2026.
Q2 growth was supported by broad-based demand across domestic and export markets despite global headwinds.
Management kept the ₹5,000 Cr revenue and ₹1,000 Cr+ EBITDA vision over three to four years, about 2x.
Chairman guides 20% CAGR with similar EBITDA margins, calling last year's number times 20% twice the minimum.
Phase-2 adds 12,000 MT to 66,000 MT and is targeted for completion by September 2027.
New Maltol, Ethyl Maltol and specialty plants are expected to be mechanically complete by mid-next year, with contributions from H2 of next financial year.
Capacity utilisation is around 90% of installed capacity.
The merger scheme has been filed with NCLT after exchange observation letters; completion is expected this financial year.
Alpha-pinene prices are at historic highs; management says CST is contracted back-to-back and GTO-based costs are passed on.
Management declined to give a volume-versus-realisation split, saying it discloses volume growth only annually.
Reiterated long-term vision of ₹5,000 Cr revenue and ₹1,000 Cr+ EBITDA in 3-4 years.
Total capacity will expand to 72,000 MTPA by June-September 2028 upon full capex completion.
EBITDA margins expected to remain sustainable at 20%+ level driven by process efficiencies.
Management remains on track to achieve ₹5,000 Cr revenue and ₹1,000 Cr+ EBITDA by FY29-30.

operating_notes.text: Operating cash flow for FY26 reached ₹550 cr with capex at ₹320 cr.
Total capacity will increase to 54,000 MTPA by June 30, 2026 upon Phase 1 expansion.
Working capital days improved to 117 days in FY26.
PRIGIV JV turned profitable in Q4 FY26 and is targeting ₹130 Cr revenue in FY27.
Capacity utilisation was around 90% of installed capacity in Q1FY27.
The PRIGIV JV generated about ₹18 Cr of revenue in Q1FY27 with 14-15% EBITDA, and its output is sold exclusively to Givaudan.
Camphor is about 4-6% of total revenue, and crude-based raw material is about 15-18% of overall purchases.
Total production capacity stands at 48,000 MTPA with 36,000 MTPA CST processing capacity and 12,000 MTPA GTO processing capacity.
About 70% of raw materials used are derived from renewable resources.

timeline.summary: CRISIL Ratings reaffirmed the long-term rating at CRISIL AA-/Stable and short-term rating at CRISIL A1+ for ₹1,118 Cr of bank facilities.
Privi Speciality Chemicals received BSE observation letter with 'no objection' for the amalgamation scheme involving Privi Fine Sciences and Privi Biotechnologies.
Privi Speciality Chemicals released its investor presentation for Q4 and FY26, highlighting ₹2,583 Cr total income and strong margin expansion.
Privi Speciality Chemicals Limited held an Analyst/Investors Meet on May 12, 2026, from 04:00 PM to 05:00 PM to discuss Q4 & FY26 audited results, with audio recording available.
Privi Speciality Chemicals held its Q4 & FY26 earnings call, guiding for 20% top-line growth in FY27 and reiterating its ₹5,000 Cr revenue roadmap.
Mahesh Purshottam Babani HUF, Karta Mahesh Purshottam Babani, and Jyoti Mahesh Babani, Promoters of Privi Speciality Chemicals Ltd, declared no encumbrances on shares for FY2025-26 on April 03, 2026.

Bhaktavatsala Doppalapudi Rao, Premaleela Doppalapudi, Vijaykumar Doppalapudi Rao, Sharon Doppalapudi, Vinaykumar Doppalapudi Rao, and Grace Vinaykumar Doppalapudi declared no encumbrances on Privi Speciality Chemicals Ltd’s shares for FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Reg. 31(4).
Rajkumar Doppalapudi and Prasanna Doppalapudi, Promoters of Privi Speciality Chemicals Ltd, declared no shares held or encumbrances as of March 31, 2026, under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).

Bhaktavatsala Doppalapudi Rao, Premaleela Doppalapudi, Vijaykumar Doppalapudi Rao, Sharon Doppalapudi, Vinaykumar Doppalapudi Rao, and Grace Vinaykumar Doppalapudi declared no encumbrances on Privi Speciality Chemicals Ltd shares for FY2025-26 on April 3, 2026.

On its 31 July 2026 Q1FY27 call, Privi guided to ₹5,000 Cr revenue and ₹1,000 Cr+ EBITDA in three to four years, said Phase-1 capacity would reach 54,000 MT by September 2026 and Phase-2 66,000 MT by September 2027, and put three-year capex at ₹850-900 Cr.

Privi Speciality Chemicals Limited approved the proposed Scheme of Amalgamation of Privi Fine Sciences Private Limited and Biotechnologies Private Limited with 89.72% votes in favour on 27 October 2026.
Privi Speciality Chemicals Limited Board declared Interim Dividend of Rs. 05 per equity share effective 29 October 2026.

Privi Speciality Chemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about outcome of the board meeting, declaration of financial results Q2 FY 27, interim dividend and proposed investment in solar power project.
Privi Speciality Chemicals released its Q2 & H1 FY27 presentation, reiterating ₹5,000 Cr revenue and ₹1,000 Cr+ EBITDA target by FY30 with H2 2028 expansion completion.

watchlist.text: NCLT sanction of the merger scheme

watchlist.response: CFO attributed it to last year's low-cost raw material and high selling prices, guided RMC at 52-55% of sales, and said other-expense savings offset it.
watchlist.text: Gross margin fell about 650 bps YoY to 44.2% even as revenue grew 20%; analysts asked how much would recover in FY27.

watchlist.response: CFO clarified the 6,000 MT slips to September 2026 and Phase-2's balance 12,000 MT completes by September 2027.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked whether Phase-2 capacity comes in June 2027 or September 2027, citing a discrepancy with the annual report.

watchlist.response: Management declined, saying it discloses volume growth only annually and calling it an all-round growth.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked for the volume growth versus realisation split.

watchlist.response: Management declined, citing a board directive to stop disclosing product mix and segments.
